create.name: Plum Village
create.bio:
Plum Village is the Zen monastery in south-west France that Thich Nhat Hanh, known to his students as Thay, founded in 1982 on a modest farm, growing out of the small community he had gathered near Paris during his exile from Vietnam. It is now the largest Buddhist monastery in Europe, with more than two hundred monks and nuns living in three hamlets in neighbouring villages, Upper Hamlet near Thénac for men and Lower and New Hamlets for women, couples and families. Since Thay's death its senior monastics, among them Brother Phap Huu and Brother Phap Linh, carry the teaching on, and it serves as the mother centre of a worldwide network of monasteries and lay sanghas.

Practice is woven into ordinary activity: sitting and walking meditation, mindful meals, work, rest and Dharma talks, with the five and fourteen mindfulness trainings as its ethical frame. Visitors come for retreats on set dates, including a long summer family gathering and holiday retreats in winter, or for days of mindfulness. Online, the monastics lead live retreats and courses, and the website keeps a large free library of talks, guided meditations, chants and practice texts.

courses.title: Christmas Holiday Retreat
courses.description: A week of mindful living over Christmas in the three French hamlets, joining the monastics in sitting, walking, meals and celebration. Lodging and vegan meals are included, with several contribution tiers.

courses.title: New Year's Retreat
courses.description: A week at Plum Village from late December into the new year, given to rest and to renewing a commitment to mindful living; families are welcome.

courses.title: Great Togetherness
courses.description: A five-day live online retreat led by the Lower Hamlet sisters on practising as a community, with talks, guided practice and sharing groups in several languages.

free_resources.title: Texts for Mindfulness Practices
free_resources.description: The core practice texts of the tradition, such as the mindfulness trainings, gathas and recitations, to read and use at home.

free_resources.title: Monastic-led Deep Relaxation: Embodying Mother Earth
free_resources.description: A guided deep relaxation led by a Plum Village monastic, resting the body and attention with the earth.

free_resources.title: Tangerine Meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided practice of eating a tangerine with full attention, a classic of the tradition.
